items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: But what happened, man, Fess had us in the studio down there all night with that.

ctx.x: I always have a question about that song.

I think I was going to ask Wardell. I was going to ask Wardell this? That lick that Fess plays, you know, that he plays on the piano? Yeah. Now, did Earl write that or did Fess write that lick? Or did you know who wrote that lick? No, well, I think Fess just come up with that itself. You think so? Yeah. That's his style, I think. But what happened, man, Fess had us in the studio down there all night with that.

The recording it looked like almost because he's the only one who wasn't reading, you know. Well, see, Fess was supposed to originally sing it, but he couldn't sing it and play it at the same time where he was playing. And so Earl wound up singing it. That's Earl singing and whistling. So Earl just wound up singing it, you know. But then another thing with Fess, the man stopped Fess from playing his left hand. Because he's playing this one hand. Because see what he was playing with his left hand in the bass was…
